title: Marker-pen highlight on mark
blurb: The flat background of <mark> is off. The canvas draws a pen stroke along each line box of each mark, under the text: highlighter, underline, circle, box or strike. Select words to add a mark, or edit the text and the strokes follow.
question: Can a canvas replace the background of <mark> with a drawn stroke that follows the mark's line boxes through edits and reflow, while the text stays selectable?
result: Yes. mark.getClientRects() gives one box per line, reported at the drawn position and scale. Edits and new marks fire paint on their own.
